title: Structure Theorem for (d,g,h)-Maps
publication: Bulletin of the Brazilian Mathematical Society, New Series 33 (2), 213-224

consultation.scope: Author full text: Section 1 framework and Theorem 1.2; Section 3 Theorem 3.2 and its density-limit setup. Journal metadata checked against the institutional record.
consultation.remaining: No full proof audit or uniform finite-size rate extraction. The arXiv deposit is from 2006; the journal publication is from 2002.

notes: The affine accelerated framework explicitly includes 3x-1. Fixed finite valuation paths correspond to controlled arithmetic progressions; a Gaussian/Brownian limit is obtained with the integer-density limit taken first. Direct prior art for signed valuation coding. This order of limits supplies neither uniform path lengths growing with log N nor a quantitative mixing rate for the nonlinear Juggler map.
